job.job_description:
The ideal candidate should have expertise in Python, SQL, AWS/Azure/GCP, LLMs, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.



Roles and Responsibility

Design and develop scalable and efficient AI models using various machine learning algorithms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI models into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines using SQL and other programming languages.
Implement automated testing and deployment scripts using Docker and Kubernetes.
Ensure seamless integration of AI models with backend services using APIs.
Participate in code reviews and improve the overall quality of the codebase.


Job Requirements

Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and other programming languages.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS/Azure/GCP.
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks and deep learning techniques.
Familiarity with containerization using Docker and orchestration using Kubernetes.
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
